# Evamore Technologies

> Evamore Technologies builds fast, search-friendly websites for home-service businesses and clinics in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), and sets up the automated quote follow-up system that turns quote requests into booked jobs.

## Studio Overview
- **Company Name:** Evamore Technologies
- **Founder & Lead Full-Stack Developer:** Kenny
- **Primary Market:** Greater Toronto Area (Toronto, Etobicoke, Mississauga, North York, Scarborough, Vaughan, Brampton, Markham, Oakville), Ontario, Canada
- **Operating Model:** Remote web studio working from Kenya with business owners in Canada on standard Toronto business hours (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST)
- **Technology Stack:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Core Value Proposition:** More customers find you. More of them book. One developer answers directly for every project, and clients approve a free custom homepage mockup before paying a cent.

## Industries We Serve
- Roofing & Exterior Contractors
- HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning)
- Plumbing & Emergency Drain Services
- Home Renovation & General Contracting
- Dental Clinics
- Electrical Contractors
- Landscaping & Outdoor Living
- Chiropractic & Physiotherapy Clinics

## Core Services (`/services`)
1. **Websites (Fast, Mobile-Ready 5-Page Builds):**
   - Includes Home, Services, About, Contact, and 1 Service-Area page.
   - Engineered with React and Next.js for sub-second mobile load speeds.
   - Features sticky tap-to-call triggers and a 30-second quote request form above the fold.
   - Typical turnaround: 5–10 business days after mockup approval.
2. **Local SEO & Google Business Profile Setup:**
   - Page titles, city/neighbourhood headings, and service-area copy written for how GTA customers search (e.g., "roofer in Etobicoke", "emergency plumber near me").
   - Complete Google Business Profile (GBP) setup and category optimization.
   - Built-in `Organization`, `ProfessionalService`, and `FAQPage` JSON-LD structured data.
3. **Automated Quote Follow-Up System:**
   - Logs every incoming quote request in one clean view.
   - Sends an instant same-day SMS/email alert to the business owner's phone the moment a lead arrives.
   - Automatically sends polite follow-up reminders at **Day 2** and **Day 5** if a quote goes unanswered.
4. **Care Plan ($150 CAD/month — Optional, Cancel Anytime):**
   - Managed high-speed hosting, SSL, daily backups, and security updates.
   - Same-week text, photo, or pricing edits.
   - Plain one-line monthly report: *Leads in · Quotes sent · Jobs booked.*

## Transparent CAD Pricing (`/pricing`)
- **Starter Site:** From **$1,500 CAD** (one-time) — 5 mobile-ready pages, quote form, tap-to-call, local SEO foundation, 100% client ownership.
- **Growth System (Most Popular):** From **$2,500 CAD** (one-time) — Everything in Starter plus instant SMS/email lead alerts, automated Day 2 & Day 5 quote follow-up sequence, and lead status tracker.
- **Care Plan:** **$150 CAD / month** (optional, month-to-month) — Managed hosting, updates, and one-line monthly lead report.
- **Payment Terms:**
  - Step 1: **$0 Free Custom Mockup** delivered within 3 business days.
  - Step 2: **50% to start** development once you approve the mockup.
  - Step 3: **50% before launch** upon approving the completed site. Client owns 100% of the code, content, and domain upon final payment.

## Verified Client Builds & Case Studies (`/work`)

- **The Wealth Code Collective:** Headed by Lavie Pittmann. High-trust advisory and consulting platform with structured client onboarding and conversion pathways.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What do you do?** We build fast, search-friendly websites for home-service businesses and clinics, and set up automated follow-up systems that answer quote requests faster.
- **Who do you work with?** Contractors, roofers, HVAC and plumbing companies, renovators, electricians, landscapers, and dental or health clinics in Toronto and the GTA.
- **Where are you based?** We work remotely from Kenya with clients in Canada, and schedule all calls and support in Toronto time (EST).
- **How long does it take?** A Starter site typically takes 5–10 business days after mockup approval.
- **Do I own the website?** Yes. Upon final payment, you own 100% of your website code, custom copy, and domain with zero lock-in.
